name: Home side
pre_registration_note: The home-field control. Everything else has to beat this, not 50%.

name: Away side
pre_registration_note: Negative control. If the harness is sound this must not rank highly.

name: Point-differential favourite
selection_rule: Select the team with the higher season-to-date points-scored-minus-allowed per game.
abstention_rule: Abstain when the two rates are within 0.50 points of each other.
pre_registration_note: The obvious favourite signal; the bar any availability signal has to clear.

name: Pythagorean favourite
selection_rule: Select the team with the higher Pythagorean expectation, exponent 2.37, from season-to-date points for and against.
abstention_rule: Abstain when the two expectations are within 0.020 of each other.
pre_registration_note: The same idea with the blowout noise damped.

name: Last-three momentum
selection_rule: Select the team with the better point differential over its last three games.
abstention_rule: Abstain if either team has fewer than three games played or the two are exactly equal.
pre_registration_note: Short-window recency. Expected to be the noisiest real signal here.

name: Rest advantage
selection_rule: Select the team with more days since its previous game.
abstention_rule: Abstain unless the difference in rest is at least two days.
pre_registration_note: Selective by construction: it only fires on bye and short-week mismatches.

name: Contrarian dog
selection_rule: Select the team with the WORSE season-to-date point differential per game.
abstention_rule: Abstain when the two rates are within 0.50 points of each other.
pre_registration_note: Second negative control. It exists to price the multiple-comparisons problem.

name: Our originated spread
selection_rule: Select the side our own fitted spread model favours (the sign of the predicted home margin).
abstention_rule: Abstain when the absolute predicted home margin is below 1.00 point.
pre_registration_note: Uses the coefficients fitted on weeks 2-4 only.

name: Home unless clearly worse
selection_rule: Select the home team unless the away team's point differential per game is better by more than 7.00 points.
pre_registration_note: Home field plus a threshold, i.e. the simplest version of a real handicap model.

name: Schedule-adjusted differential
selection_rule: Select the team with the higher point differential per game after subtracting the average point differential per game of the opponents it has faced.
abstention_rule: Abstain when the two adjusted rates are within 0.50 points of each other.
pre_registration_note: Strength of schedule, one iteration, no convergence.
